tokenizer_binding.encoding_protocol: Prompt and candidate continuation are encoded separately without BOS/EOS.

analysis_policy.canonical_margin: logit(lower discriminative token) - logit(upper discriminative token)

raw_direction.negative_delta: intact head supports LOWER relative to UPPER
raw_direction.positive_delta: intact head supports UPPER relative to LOWER

correctness_effect.positive_effect: intact head supports the correct candidate
correctness_effect.negative_effect: intact head suppresses the correct candidate

within_pair_direction_stability.pass_rule: At least 3 of 4 raw ablation deltas have the same non-zero sign.

cross_pair_generalization.pass_rule: Within-pair direction stability passes on at least 3 of the 4 new primary pairs.

strong_correctness_tracking.pass_rule: At least 12 of 16 primary correctness effects are positive.
strong_correctness_tracking.interpretation: Passing this test is evidence for a strong arithmetic-correctness account and therefore works against the candidate-selection replication claim.

positive_control_tests.overall_pass: Both L1H0 and L4H0 positive-control tests pass.

weak_control_test.head: L4H1
weak_control_test.metric: mean absolute raw ablation delta across the 16 primary replication probes
weak_control_test.pass_rule: L4H1 mean absolute delta is strictly lower than the mean absolute delta of each primary head on the same probes.

orientation_diagnostic.purpose: Distinguish pair/token-specific stability from a trivial global LOWER-versus-UPPER ordering bias.
orientation_diagnostic.metric: For each primary head, compare the dominant raw-delta sign across the stable primary pairs.
orientation_diagnostic.global_order_bias_signal: The same dominant raw-delta sign occurs in every stable primary pair.
orientation_diagnostic.pair_dependent_signal: At least two stable primary pairs have opposite dominant raw-delta signs.
orientation_diagnostic.note: This diagnostic does not alter the preregistered primary replication pass/fail result; it refines mechanism interpretation.

outcome_policy.condition: Positive control passes; both L1H0 and L4H0 pass cross-pair generalization; neither primary head passes strong correctness tracking; and the L4H1 weak-control criterion passes.
Positive control passes and exactly one of L1H0/L4H0 passes cross-pair generalization, or both pass but one also passes strong correctness tracking, with weak-control behavior still acceptable.
Positive control passes but neither primary head passes cross-pair generalization, or the weak-control criterion fails.

execution_protocol.scoring_context_protocol: For every probe, construct the scoring context as frozen prompt_token_ids followed by the frozen shared-prefix token IDs that occur before the first candidate-discriminative token.
execution_protocol.approval_gate_position: The runner must verify the approval artifact and all frozen bindings before instantiating LaboratoryRuntime or loading checkpoint weights.
